name: GX700 GRX 1×12

editorial.verdict: A strong proper-gravel specification, but weak value relative to the Twitter EDS unless Shimano and 45C are worth almost twice the price.
caveats: Approximately twice the Twitter EDS price

claimed_complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer page claims about 10.2 kg for a small complete bike excluding pedals and small accessories; its current 26–36T crank detail conflicts with this target 1×12 variant, so exact build mapping is uncertain.
purchase_route: Current CAMP mainland GX700 page shows CNY 9,999, Add to Cart and JD Buy Now with size/color selection and stock-dependent cancellation; the 2026-08-28 Tmall listing also showed CNY 9,999. Current crank detail conflicts with the target 1×12 build, and exact selected-SKU checkout remains unverified.
